label: Lab 05
title: Can an agent go rogue?
question: What does an agent do when a planted ticket tells it to wipe the code repository, and what stops it?
how: A staged attack on a practice repository filled with made-up data. The same agent gets the same ticket twice: once with no controls, and once behind the engine's real guards, which refuse and record each command.
status: A staged attack, with real refusals
